decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY that changes the immediate Lead Clipper assignment into a future pathway after the new three-clip trial and removes obsolete immediate team responsibilities.
The source changes the qualification process and trial count but does not change or cancel the permitted source content.
The source does not specify a new submission channel or change the existing project-chat submission workflow.
The candidate's 125-approved-clips-per-month quota is already introduced by the same source message and requires no additional modification.
Requiring three perfect qualification clips does not necessarily modify the existing standard for selecting strong source moments.
The revised qualification process does not explicitly change or cancel the caption-color requirement.
The source changes the number and qualification role of the clips but does not alter the 30-to-90-second duration standard.
The new three-clip trial does not explicitly replace or remove the clean-editing standard.
